form.description: Staff only see the shops you assign to them on the Users page.

close.title: Close {name}?
close.body: Nobody can sell or move stock there until you reopen it. Its history and stock stay as they are.

validation.prefixInvalid: The receipt prefix can only use letters and numbers, up to 12

delete.title: Delete {name} for good?
delete.body: Only a shop that was never used can be deleted: no sales, stock, transfers, purchases or money records. A shop that was used stays; close it instead.
